settings.label: Folder
settings.help: Where Codex starts; ~ is your home. Applies the next time it starts (the restart button).

settings.label: Command
settings.help: The command line that runs Codex. Options that change its config (-c, --search, --enable) run it without its shared background server. Applies the next time it starts.

settings.label: Stop when idle
settings.help: Codex takes 500 to 700 MB, besides its shared background server. Closed and not working this long, it stops; the next time the notch opens, a new Codex starts (/resume brings the thread back). 0 keeps it running.

settings.label: Font
settings.help: A monospace font family for the terminal; empty uses the theme's. Applies the next time it starts.
